notes: Stance agreed on all 3 documents. Main disagreements: (1) phase, general vs during-work/course-start for principle and rationale sentences in the TLC templates, resolved by whether the sentence states a principle (general) or governs doing the work (during-work); (2) actor all vs student/admin/ta-staff, resolved by who the sentence binds ('this course', 'we' = all; contractors and employees = all); (3) unit_stance permit vs neutral on citation/acknowledgement units, resolved as permit because they condition permitted use, and neutral for definitions and disclosure-to-vendor rules; (4) policy_type on the records policy, where P56/P50/P19 were over-stretched, so malware ban, official-statements ban and breach reporting are UNCOVERED, and 'exercise good judgment' is P04; 'will not need to use AI' is P03, not P01; (5) coverage: kept 3 A-only and 5 B-only units that are real statements; dropped 2 A-only/1 B-only items (a generic 'examples below' line, a background sentence on provost page, and an exact repeat of a transparency sentence). No new_types: the uncovered units are singletons or security-procedure items for the memo.
